items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Cootie and I were good friends.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, yeah yeah I was glad to be on the scene, no gettin' around that. Just ~~on to~~ be among them. You know, I was just sittin' around lookin' at everybody [ha ha], in awe, as you might say -- to be a member of that, you know great guys like that...
Wasn't Cootie Williams there, yeah -- Cootie and I were good friends. Then I made -- records with Johnny Hodges --
